sloka: सताम् लोकात् सताम् कीर्त्याः सज् जुष्टात् कर्मणः तथा ।भ्रश्यतु क्षिप्रम् अद्य एव यस्य आर्यो अनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-४७॥
transliteration: satām lokāt satām kīrtyāḥ saj juṣṭāt karmaṇaḥ tathā ।bhraśyatu kṣipram adya eva yasya āryo anumate gataḥ ॥2-75-47॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be expelled this very moment from the world approved by virtuous men, from their renown and from their (noble) actions
